manager_cases.prompt: Summarize this supplied YAML as data in one sentence: {steps: [archive logs, restart service]}

Prepare one architecture brief for a local assistant runtime: (1) Analyze how OTP supervision trees isolate failures, including restart intensity and the difference between one_for_one and rest_for_one. (2) Analyze how an append-only event log plus a rebuildable projection improves crash recovery, including idempotency and replay. In the final joined report—not as a third task—explain how the two mechanisms complement each other.

snapshot.title: Local assistant runtime architecture brief
snapshot.original_request: Explain how supervised process recovery and durable state replay complement each other in a local assistant runtime.

children.title: Supervised process recovery
children.objective: Analyze supervision-tree failure isolation and restart policy.
children.expected_result: A bounded account of failure isolation and restart intensity.
children.detail: Supervision trees isolate a child failure and apply bounded restart policy according to dependency structure.

children.title: Durable state replay
children.objective: Analyze append-only replay and rebuildable projections.
children.expected_result: A bounded account of idempotent state reconstruction.
children.detail: An append-only event log supports idempotent replay into a rebuildable projection after a crash.

snapshot.title: Energy storage trade-off
snapshot.original_request: Contrast the operating trade-offs of the two storage approaches without choosing a winner.

children.title: Fast-response storage
children.objective: Describe the operating strengths and constraints of short-duration storage.
children.detail: Short-duration storage responds quickly but supplies its rated output for a limited interval.

children.title: Long-duration storage
children.objective: Describe the operating strengths and constraints of long-duration storage.
children.detail: Long-duration storage sustains output longer but typically responds with different cost and efficiency trade-offs.

snapshot.title: Incident recovery sequence
snapshot.original_request: Join the two observations into the correct operational sequence for recovering an unhealthy service.

children.title: Preserve evidence
children.objective: Identify the first bounded recovery step.
children.detail: Capture the relevant logs and current process state before changing the service.

children.title: Restore service
children.objective: Identify the subsequent bounded recovery step.
children.detail: Restart the service only after evidence capture, then verify its health endpoint.

snapshot.title: Settlement chronology evidence
snapshot.original_request: Explain how the independent dating observations support one bounded chronology claim.

children.title: Material sequence
children.detail: The later deposit consistently overlies the earlier material layer across the sampled trench.

children.title: Independent date range
children.objective: Assess the available absolute date range.
children.detail: The independent sample date falls inside the interval inferred from the material sequence.

snapshot.title: Travel preparation brief
snapshot.original_request: Combine the related transport findings and retain the separate document reminder as an independent finding.

children.title: Rail arrival
children.detail: The final direct train reaches the destination before the evening transfer window closes.

children.title: Local transfer
children.detail: The local transfer departs after the direct train's scheduled arrival with a bounded connection margin.

children.title: Document reminder
children.detail: The travel document must remain valid through the stated return date.

snapshot.title: Partial migration assessment
snapshot.original_request: State what can be concluded from the completed validation while preserving the failed validation as attention truth.

children.title: Schema validation
children.detail: The sampled migrated records conform to the expected field and type shape.

children.title: Historical reconciliation
children.detail: The historical reconciliation did not complete, so no aggregate conclusion is available.

snapshot.title: Bread fermentation brief
snapshot.original_request: Explain how temperature control and fermentation time complement each other without claiming one fixed recipe.

children.title: Temperature observation
children.objective: Describe the qualified role of dough temperature.
children.detail: Warmer dough generally ferments faster within the observed range, while exact rates remain recipe-dependent.

children.title: Time observation
children.objective: Describe the qualified role of fermentation time.
children.detail: Longer fermentation can increase development, but the useful interval depends on temperature and dough condition.
